mapper.select: SELECT public_notice_id FROM performance_public_notice WHERE performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} ORDER BY created_dttm DESC, performance_public_notice_id DESC

SELECT link.public_notice_id FROM performance_public_notice link JOIN public_notice notice ON notice.public_notice_id = link.public_notice_id WHERE link.performance_project_id = #{performanceProjectId} AND notice.status_code IN ('SCHEDULED', 'PUBLISHED') AND notice.publish_start_dttm <= #{currentDttm} AND (notice.publish_end_dttm IS NULL OR notice.publish_end_dttm > #{currentDttm}) AND notice.deleted_dttm IS NULL ORDER BY notice.is_pinned DESC, notice.publish_start_dttm DESC, notice.public_notice_id DESC
